name: record-peek
title: Record Peek
description: A record opened beside its list — a non-modal, resizable side panel whose header walks the list (↑/↓, J/K, n of N), opens the full page (⌘↵) and closes with focus back on the row; full-screen below the tablet tier.

meta.whenToUse: Opening any record from a list — a task, a table row, a meeting, a customer — beside the list, with keyboard walking and a way to the full page.
meta.whenNotToUse: A document or file that opens as its own page or viewer, or a form that needs the page to wait (Dialog, Sheet).
